stages.prompt: I need a small project tracker. The app's records are Project { name, tasks } and ProjectTask { title, done, project }. Names and titles are text; done is true/false. One project has many tasks, and each task belongs to one project. Use real relationships so we can follow those links in both directions. Please create the record types.

params.name: schema
params.sdl: type Project { name: String tasks: [ProjectTask] } type ProjectTask { title: String done: Boolean project: Project }
